name: Alice Gu
bio: Alice Gu is known for The Donut King (2020), Shimmer, Inspired by Eva Young (2024) and Really Good Rejects (2022)

credits.title: The Elephant Odyssey
credits.overview: The highly unusual trek by a herd of elephants as they diverted from their usual habitat and marched over 1,000 km in China across remote Yunnan Province. They attracted global attention, including live-streamed drone footage.

credits.title: Raised by Waves
credits.overview: The documentary follows teenage surfing prodigies Justin (15), Eric (15), and "Baby" Steve Roberson (14) as they prepare to ride the legendary, perilous swells of Maui's iconic JAWS.

credits.title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
credits.overview: Three filmmakers dive deep into the storied and complex legacy of Ms. magazine through the lens of some of its most iconic covers, featuring never-before-seen archival footage and engaging interviews with the powerful women who shaped the magazine at its inception over fifty years ago

credits.title: Shimmer, Inspired by Eva Young
credits.overview: After winning Miss International National USA as his alter-ago Ai Mei Shimmer, closeted drag performer and doctor, Ethan Gao, must rush to the hospital when a close patient begins to code, threatening their secret passion of drag.

credits.title: Really Good Rejects
credits.overview: The muted tones of rubber bridge guitars have delighted listeners the world over- from Wilco to Taylor Swift’s Folklore. Modern-day luthier Reuben Cox demystifies his process of creating some of rock’s most sought-after guitars.

credits.title: The Donut King
credits.overview: Cambodian refugee Ted Ngoy builds a multi-million dollar empire by baking America's favourite pastry: the doughnut.

credits.title: The Road to El Camino: Behind the Scenes of El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie
credits.overview: Aaron Paul, Vince Gilligan and other cast members, producers and crew share stories and footage from the making of "El Camino."

credits.title: Take Every Wave: The Life of Laird Hamilton
credits.overview: This is the remarkable story of an American icon who changed the sport of big wave surfing forever. Transcending the surf genre, this in-depth portrait of a hard-charging athlete explores the fear, courage and ambition that push a man to greatness—and the cost that comes with it.
